title: 第48章 我怕得要死
content_zh:
第48章 我怕得要死-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

上一章

存书签

下一章

议论声嗡嗡的，像一群蜜蜂在耳边飞。

林国强没心思听这些，他转身就往回走。

卷帘门已经拉开了一半，赵志军从里面探出脑袋来，脸上又惊又怕又佩服，表情复杂得很。

“三姐夫！你没事吧？！”

“没事。”

赵素梅从卷帘门后面冲出来，一把抓住他的胳膊，上下打量了一遍。

看见他脖子上的血印子，脸一下子白了。

看见他被削掉一截的棉袄袖子，嘴唇都哆嗦起来。

看见他手上蹭的血，眼泪顿时掉了下来。

“你受伤了！”

“皮外伤，不碍事。”

“这还不叫碍事？！都出血了！”

“真没事。”林国强把脖子上的血印子给她看，“就划了一下，破了点皮，回去抹点红药水就好了。”

赵素梅咬着嘴唇，一边哭一边骂：“你这个傻子！不要命了！

你要是出了事，我和静静、薇薇怎么办？！你怎么就不想想我们？！”

林国强没说话，伸手把她揽进怀里。

赵素梅在他怀里哭，肩膀一抽一抽的，手攥着他的衣角。

店里的客人陆续出来了，站在门口看着街上的动静。

有人小声议论，有人摇头叹气，有人帮着去扶那个被砍伤的男人。

他已经被抬到路边，胳膊上缠着布条，但血还是止不住，布条被染成了暗红色。

“让一让！让一让！”

人群自动让开一条路。

一个穿着警服的中年男人从街那头跑过来，跑得满头大汗，腰上的枪套一晃一晃的。

他冲到周红身边，蹲下来，看见被绑住手脚、躺在地上狼狈不堪的女人，脸色骤变。

“红妹……红妹……”他的声音在发抖，伸出手想去摸她的脸，又缩回来了。

他站起来，看了看周围，目光在人群中扫了一圈。

“是谁？”他的声音沙哑，“谁制住的？”

中年男人指了指林国强：“那边那个，对面小吃店的老板。”

刘强顺着他的手指看过来，目光落在林国强身上。

他走过来，站在林国强面前，上下打量了他一眼。

这个穿警服的男人四十出头，方脸膛，浓眉毛，嘴唇很厚，下巴上有一颗黑痣。

他的眼睛里有血丝，眼圈微微发红，但腰杆挺得笔直，军人的底子还在。

The buzzing sound was like a swarm of bees flying around my ears.

Lin Guoqiang had no intention of listening to this, so he turned around and walked back.

The rolling shutter door had been opened halfway, and Zhao Zhijun poked his head out from inside, with a complex expression of shock, fear, and admiration on his face.

"Third brother-in-law! Are you okay?!"

"It's okay."

Zhao Sumei rushed out from behind the rolling shutter door, grabbed his arm, and looked him up and down.

Seeing the blood marks on his neck, his face suddenly turned pale.

Seeing the sleeve of his cotton-padded jacket with a section cut off, my lips trembled.

Seeing the blood on his hands, tears fell immediately.

"You're hurt!"

"Skin injury, nothing to worry about."

"Isn't this a hindrance?! He's bleeding!"

"It's really okay." Lin Guoqiang showed her the blood marks on his neck. "It was just a scratch and the skin was broken. Just go back and apply some red lotion and it will be fine."

Zhao Sumei bit her lip, crying and scolding: "You fool! Don't kill me!"

If something happens to you, what will Jingjing, Weiwei and I do?!Why don't you think about us?!"

Lin Guoqiang said nothing, and stretched out his hand to take her into his arms.

Zhao Sumei cried in his arms, her shoulders twitching and her hands holding the corners of his clothes.

The customers in the store came out one after another and stood at the door watching the movement on the street.

Some people whispered, some shook their heads and sighed, and some helped the man who was chopped.

He had been carried to the side of the road, with a cloth strip wrapped around his arm, but the bleeding still couldn't be stopped, and the cloth strip was dyed dark red.

"Give way! Give way!"

The crowd automatically moved out of the way.

A middle-aged man in police uniform ran over from the other side of the street, sweating profusely as he ran, the holster on his waist flickering.

He rushed to Zhou Hong, squatted down, and saw the woman with her hands and feet tied, lying on the ground in a miserable state, and his expression suddenly changed.

"Hongmei...Hongmei..." His voice was trembling, and he stretched out his hand to touch her face, but then retracted it.

He stood up, looked around, and scanned the crowd.

"Who?" His voice was hoarse, "Who stopped it?"

The middle-aged man pointed at Lin Guoqiang: "That one over there, the owner of the snack bar opposite."

Liu Qiang followed his finger and looked over, his eyes falling on Lin Guoqiang.

He came over, stood in front of Lin Guoqiang, and looked him up and down.

This man in police uniform is in his early forties, with a square face, thick eyebrows, thick lips, and a black mole on his chin.

His eyes were bloodshot and the circles under his eyes were slightly red, but his waist was straight and his military qualities were still there.
